pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Nexus is an offline-first desktop workspace: tasks, calendar, notes, documents, study, habits, fitness and finance in one encrypted local database. Everything is stored on the device in SQLCipher- encrypted SQLite. Network use is a mode of the whole device and the default is Offline only, in which the app makes no network call of any kind.
This package installs the prebuilt x86_64 Electron bundle — portage does not rebuild Chromium from the application source.
